# Q01 EGIA stale replay cases

[中文](README_cn.md) · [Owner contract](../../../../docs/ei/interfaces/vision-evidence.md)

`cases.json` freezes the compare-only identity mutations and the protocol and lifecycle negatives for the private one-shot test socket. `tests/egia/test_vision_evidence.py` loads its identity matrix and exercises the live local socket, same admission body, lock ordering, default absence, grant loss and Stop. These are EGIA owner tests; a selected IsOS/EOS/EGIA Q01 process receipt is separate.
